1. PR Lens by Coldtea.ai

Tagline: See code through a new lens
Description: PR Lens is a new way to look at code. It draws animated architecture and data flow diagrams of any codebase and every pull request, so you see the change before you read a single line of code. It runs as a GitHub Action, on the CLI, or as a skill for your coding agent. Open source under MIT.
Website: open

5. Airuncode

Tagline: Run multiple local coding agents on your machine
Description: Airuncode is a local-first agent runtime for serious software work. Run multiple coding agents on your machine, bring your own API keys, switch between cloud and local models, and pay providers directly with zero token markup. It scans your codebase, debates solutions across agents, edits files, runs tests and self-heals failures. It also ships with V-CORE, a native Vulkan 3D runtime for AI-assisted game development. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.

7. Bloop

Tagline: Turn any Mac audio into a visual you can actually export
Description: Bloop turns system audio or mic input into eight real-time shader skins - every frame reacts to what’s actually playing. Keep it beside your work in the resizable Mini Player or send it to the menu bar. Drop in an MP3 playlist and export the whole thing as a finished video. Apple Silicon, notarized, no subscription. Two skins are free forever, and they’re the full app, not a trial.

8. Clipnote

Tagline: Save your AI conversations so they persist after closing tab
Description: Your ChatGPT and Claude conversations disappear the moment you close the tab. With Clipnote, just tell your AI to “save this” and it’s kept on the spot — pasting it in works too, of course. It’s a place to keep your AI conversations like a notepad, come back to them later, and pick up right where you left off.

Description: Remind puts your next meeting on every screen, with an AI briefing on who you are meeting and a one-click join button. Stay focused until it is time to join. 10. Nina by Antalpha

Tagline: Non-custodial AI Agent: research, predict & trade crypto
Description: Nina is a non-custodial AI trading assistant by Antalpha (NASDAQ: ANTA). Unlike generic chatbots, it’s wired to institutional-grade, real-time data and answers conclusion-first, with charts—not walls of text. Ask in plain language; Nina drafts the trade, prediction, or safety check—you sign on your own wallet. One chat now covers crypto and US stocks: market intel, smart-money tracking, predictions & Polymarket, wallet-safety checks—plus Sentinel 24/7 alerts and MCP for any AI client.
